items.q: What is a residential proxy?
items.a: A residential proxy uses IP addresses assigned through real home broadband networks, mimicking ordinary user behavior. Compared with datacenter proxies, residential IPs are much harder for target sites to detect and block — the first choice for data extraction, scraping, account registration and ad verification.

items.q: Why use residential proxy IPs?
items.a: Residential proxies effectively bypass anti-scraping mechanisms and reduce ban risk. With high anonymity and stability, they suit cross-border e-commerce, social media operations, market research, SEO monitoring, ad verification and other businesses that need large volumes of high-quality IPs.

items.q: Static vs rotating residential proxies — what's the difference?
items.a: Static residential proxies provide long-lived unchanging IPs, ideal for account nurturing and long-term extraction where IP stability matters. Rotating residential proxies change IPs periodically, suited to large-scale scraping, short-term tasks and anonymous browsing.

items.q: What scenarios suit static residential proxies?
items.a: Cross-border e-commerce account nurturing, social media account management, long-term data extraction, ad delivery, brand protection, security testing — any scenario that demands IP stability and security.

items.q: What billing options are available?

faq.title: FAQ
faq.sub: Common questions about IPFlex AI Accelerator.

items.q: What is IPFlex AI Accelerator?
items.a: It is a network optimization service for overseas AI tools, combining residential IPs, smart DNS management, and WebRTC protection.

items.q: Will it affect local websites and apps?
items.a: No. It focuses on overseas AI service access while keeping normal local website usage unaffected.

items.q: Why use static residential IPs?
items.a: Residential IPs are assigned by ISPs and usually carry a more trusted identity than datacenter IPs.

items.q: Why do DNS and WebRTC protection matter?
items.a: DNS queries and WebRTC can expose real network signals even when the exit IP looks clean. The client reduces these leaks.

items.q: Which operating systems are supported?
items.a: Windows 10/11 and macOS 12+ are currently supported.

items.q: Can I use multiple devices?
items.a: Yes. Purchased IPs can sync across devices logged in with the same account.
